items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I used to go over to his house, and he'd show me everything about reading. That's how I learned how to read, from Jack.

ctx.x: Oh, the saxophone player. Little Jack.

Yeah. I used to go over to his house, and he'd show me everything about reading. That's how I learned how to read, from Jack. But I took a course in public school music and like that. And this was what you'd say--what you'd teach in the elementary grades, you know, the fundamentals of music. Write a line of melody notes; then you'd find out what chords you'd put with it. Then you'd find out what your signature is like. Very elementary, music.
Yeah. Well, so in a sense, you sort of--you picked up your knowledge as you went along?
